errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.
errors.not-provisioned: Your sign-in worked, but this account has not been set up for CrewSafe yet. Ask your site administrator to add you.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this. If you think you should, ask your site administrator.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this first. Reload and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our end. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Cannot reach CrewSafe. Check your connection and try again.
errors.configMissing: The app is not configured. Missing: {{keys}}

codes.NO_ACTIVE_POLICY: This site has no active heat policy, so a plan cannot be drafted. Ask a Safety Manager to activate a policy version.
codes.NO_USABLE_WBGT: There is no usable WBGT reading for this site yet, so a plan cannot be drafted. Try again once a reading arrives.

auth.pkceHint: You will be taken to the secure CrewSafe sign-in page in your browser.

validation.passwordTooShort: Your password is at least {{min}} characters.

cognito.invalidCredentials: That username or password is not right.
cognito.newPasswordRequired: This account still has its temporary password. Set a permanent one in the AWS Console before signing in here.
cognito.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
cognito.pkceUnavailableInExpoGo: Hosted UI sign-in needs a development build on a phone, because Expo Go cannot open a crewsafe:// link. Run the app with `npx expo start --web --port 5173` to test this flow, or use another mode.

signUp.title: Request an account
signUp.intro: CrewSafe accounts are created by your site administrator. Fill this in and we will show you exactly what to send them.
signUp.fullNamePlaceholder: Your name as it appears on site records
signUp.siteLabel: Which site do you work at?
signUp.roleNotice: Only Worker accounts can be requested here. Supervisor, Safety Manager and Administrator accounts are created by an administrator.
signUp.successBody: Send these details to your site administrator. They will create your account and you will receive an invitation by email.

validation.usernameFormat: Use lowercase letters and numbers, separated by . _ or - only.
validation.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
validation.singleLineOnly: Remove line breaks and special formatting characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.textSizePreview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
settings.highContrastHint: Stronger colours and thicker outlines, for reading the screen in direct sunlight.
settings.reduceMotionHint: On by default. Stops icons animating, except the stop-work warning. Always on if your device has Reduce Motion enabled.
settings.aboutBody: Heat-stress safety for outdoor crews in Singapore.

profile.title: Profile
profile.photoLocalOnly: Your photo is stored on this phone only. It is not sent to CrewSafe and your supervisor will not see it.
profile.cameraDeniedBody: CrewSafe needs camera access to take a photo. You can turn it on in your device settings.
profile.libraryDeniedBody: CrewSafe needs photo access to choose a picture. You can turn it on in your device settings.

shifts.emptyBody: Shifts you plan for this site will appear here.
shifts.noSitesBody: You are not assigned to a site yet. Ask your administrator to add you.
shifts.unknownWorker: Worker no longer on this site
shifts.deleteBody: This removes the shift and everything assigned to it. It cannot be undone.

form.crewHint: Choose the workers for this shift. You can also create the shift now and add people later.
form.noWorkers: This site has no assignable workers yet.
form.acclimatisationHint: Only for a worker in their first seven days, or returning after more than a week.
form.unstaffedNotice: This shift will be created with nobody assigned. You can staff it later.

validation.endNotAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
validation.acclimatisationRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 7, or leave it blank.
validation.checkFields: Some details above need attention. The fields with a red outline show what to fix.

shifts.notEditable: This shift has ended and can no longer be edited.
shifts.editActiveBody: Changing intensity now changes the heat rules this worker is already working under. Continue?
shifts.editWindowHint: This moves the whole crew, not one worker.
shifts.editWindowActiveBody: Moving the times changes when {{crew}} worker(s) are expected on site. Continue?
shifts.addWorkerNoneLeft: Everyone at this site is already on this shift.
shifts.removeWorkerBody: Remove {{name}} from this shift? Their task and acclimatisation day are discarded.

weather.title: Conditions
weather.noSitesBody: You are not assigned to a site yet. Ask your site administrator to add you.
weather.noReadingBody: This site has no weather reading yet. It will appear once the next reading is ingested.

forecast.title: WBGT forecast
forecast.intro: Predicted heat stress for this site. A forecast is not a measurement — each value is shown with the range it is likely to fall in.
forecast.unavailableBody: This site has no usable reading recent enough to forecast from, or conditions are changing too fast to give a useful range. The current reading is unaffected.
forecast.noBandNote: No risk band is shown for a forecast. Bands are decided by the heat policy on the server, and one has not yet been evaluated for predicted values.

basisNote.MODEL_IMPUTED: A missing reading was filled in before the model ran. The likely range is wider to reflect that.
basisNote.TREND: Not enough recent readings for the model, so this projects the recent trend. Treat it as indicative and read the range, not the number.
basisNote.PERSISTENCE: This carries the last reading forward, because no recent trend could be established. Treat it as a rough guide only.

inbox.emptyBody: Approved actions from your supervisor will appear here.
inbox.safeToRetry: Tapping again is safe — it will not acknowledge twice.

lightning.stopWorkBody: Lightning near this site. Seek proper shelter immediately.
lightning.advisoryBody: Lightning detected near this site. Be ready to stop work.
lightning.expiredBody: The warning lapsed at {{time}}. Resume work only when your supervisor confirms the all-clear.
lightning.overrideNotice: Heat plan suspended while stop-work is in effect.
lightning.unavailable: Lightning data unavailable for this site.

guidance.title: What you must do
guidance.suspended: Suspended — lightning stop-work overrides the heat plan
guidance.none: No heat actions required right now.

actions.HYDRATE_HOURLY: Drink water at least once an hour
actions.SHADE_RECOVERY: Take recovery breaks in the shade
actions.RESCHEDULE_HEAVY_WORK: Reschedule heavy work if you can
actions.REST_10_MIN_HOURLY: Rest 10 minutes without a break, every hour
actions.REST_15_MIN_HOURLY: Rest 15 minutes without a break, every hour
actions.CLOSE_MONITORING: Watch yourself and your crew closely for heat illness

shift.title: Your shift
shift.noShiftBody: You have no current or upcoming shift. Check with your supervisor.

freshness.simulatedNotice: Simulated data. Not a real reading — no lightning or conditions endpoint exists yet.
freshness.staleWarning: This reading is too old to rely on. Do not treat it as current — follow your site's procedure or ask your supervisor for a confirmed reading.
freshness.delayedWarning: This reading arrived later than expected. Conditions may have changed since it was taken.

dev.lostResponseHint: The server commits the acknowledgement, then the reply is dropped. Retry and the count below must stay at 1.
dev.weatherHint: Sets the underlying rainfall, wind and humidity — the condition is still classified from those numbers, not set directly.
dev.forbiddenHint: The story's 403 case is otherwise unreachable — the picker only offers sites you belong to. You should stay signed in and see an explanation.
dev._mockInstructionNote: Fixture instruction bodies for the mock dispatch server. Under dev.* because they stand in for supervisor-authored server data that does not exist in mock mode. Underscore-prefixed, so the parity check skips it. See api/mock/dispatch.ts and the untranslatable-instruction note in the README.

mockInstruction.REST_15_MIN: Take a continuous 15-minute rest in the shaded rest point by the site office.
mockInstruction.HYDRATE: Drink 500ml of water now and refill your bottle before returning to the verge.
mockInstruction.ROTATE_TO_LIGHT_DUTY: Swap to the tool store for the next hour. Your supervisor has arranged cover.

placeholder.screenPending: This screen is next in the build order.

recommendations.title: AI-drafted plans
recommendations.emptyBody: Drafted plans needing your decision will appear here.
recommendations.untranslatedNotice: Written by the server — shown in English.
recommendations.readOnlyNotice: You can read this plan but not decide on it.
recommendations.approveBody: Every worker on this shift receives these actions in their own language.
recommendations.rejectBody: Say why. This is kept on the record beside the draft.
recommendations.rejectReasonRequired: A reason is required to reject.
recommendations.editHint: Remove or reorder actions and correct their wording. You cannot add new ones — an added action would have no policy rule behind it.
recommendations.editEmpty: Keep at least one action, or reject the plan instead.
recommendations.alreadyDecided: Someone has already decided this plan.
recommendations.requiredCannotRemove: Required by the heat policy — you cannot remove this.

wellbeing.logFailed: Could not save that. Try again.
wellbeing.concernBody: Pick anything that applies. You can add a note if you want to.
wellbeing.concernEmpty: Pick at least one, or write a note.
wellbeing.concernsEmptyBody: If a worker reports feeling unwell, it appears here.
wellbeing.alreadyAcknowledged: Someone else marked this as seen first.
wellbeing.untranslatedNote: Written by the worker in their own language.

policy.entryHint: Thresholds in force at this site
policy.title: Heat policy versions
policy.emptyBody: This site has no heat policy version yet.
policy.readOnlyNotice: You can read the policy but not change it.
policy.clonedFrom: Starting from {{label}}. Change only what the revision changes.
policy.clonedFromNone: No version to copy — enter the full set of thresholds.
policy.duplicateLabel: A version with this label already exists at this site.
policy.activateBody: {{incoming}} replaces {{outgoing}}. Every recommendation from now on is judged against the new thresholds.
policy.activateBodyFirst: {{incoming}} becomes the first active policy for this site.
policy.alreadyActive: This version is already the active one.
policy.supersededCannotActivate: A retired version cannot be brought back. Create a new version instead.

validation.labelTooLong: Keep the label to {{max}} characters or fewer.
validation.sourceRequired: Say where these rules come from.
validation.sourceTooLong: Keep the source to {{max}} characters or fewer.
validation.dateRequired: Pick the date this takes effect.
validation.ordering: Within each level, light must be at least moderate, and moderate at least heavy.
